facts.text: Under the D-Plan, the year has four terms including summer. Students are on campus for all of first year, the summer after sophomore year and at least two senior terms, and fit 12 terms into 15, with at most seven fall or spring terms on campus.

sources.title: Dartmouth ORC 2025-26: Enrollment Patterns (D-Plans)
sources.quote: All students are expected to be in residence during the summer term that immediately follows the sophomore year
